title: Trump dined with the Anthropic CEO who called for AI slowdown
description: The president’s first one-on-one meeting with Dario Amodei followed months of tensions.

title: In Iowa, Republicans feel the heat and try to motivate ‘frustrated’ base
description: The political environment for the party has led to widespread alarm. “It feels like it could be a wipeout,” one strategist said.

title: Trump says he has an off-ramp to his biggest political problem. He refuses to take it.
description: There is nothing holding back Republican political fortunes this year more than the war that President Donald Trump started with Iran.

title: Senate Republicans make a final legislative push ahead of the midterms
description: In their last week in Washington before the elections, GOP lawmakers are pressing their party to do more to address the cost of living.

title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
description: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

title: What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump
description: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in Congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

title: Taxpayer-funded Trump administration ads raise questions about their legality
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former White House ethics czar Norman Eisen about the ethical and legal questions raised by new Trump administration advertisements, which are funded by taxpayer money.

title: White House expands taxpayer-paid ad campaign boosting Trump
description: The taxpayer-funded campaign borrows the president's political rhetoric as the White House defends the spots as “public service” announcements.

title: This Texas crooner could help Democrats win Congress, one quinceañera at a time
description: Bobby Pulido would be the only member of Congress with a Latin Grammy to his name. That comes with its upsides and downsides.

title: In Knoxville, cheers for Trump — and some quiet doubts
description: The president, booed at other big sporting events this year, drew mostly cheers at Neyland Stadium. In the parking lots, some of his own voters had misgivings.

title: Soaring diesel prices are clobbering Trump’s MAGA faithful, exposing rifts
description: Pain at the pump for rural Republicans is shifting the political map.

title: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table
description: The Protect College Sports Act is on the brink of passing in the Senate, where a handful of former college athletes who are now senators on both sides of the aisle have an extra say in the debate.

title: Ohio governor's race: Ramaswamy and Acton clash in rare Democratic pickup opportunity
description: The Ohio governor's race pits former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton, a former state health advisor. Democrats see a chance to win a state that usually votes Republican.

title: Politics chat: Trump vs the media; rolling back health and education spending
description: We look at President Trump's fight with some of the White House press corps, as well as his attempt to claw back $810 million in Congressionally-approved funds for health and education spending.

title: These Democrats are making Christianity a centerpiece of their midterm campaigns
description: It's rare for Democrats to make religion a centerpiece of their campaigns. But this midterm election cycle, a number of candidates for Congress are doing just that.

title: Lawmakers slam Trump’s move to cancel $810M in funding approved by Congress
description: The White House announced plans to cancel funding for refugee services and other domestic programs. Lawmakers say it infringes on their spending authority.

title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
description: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

title: Press pool dispute escalates as White House cuts CNN from Air Force One travel
description: The White House has barred CNN from traveling on Air Force One this weekend. It's another chapter in President Trump's fight with the press, and it appears there will be no TV pool coverage today.

title: Supreme Court rejects GOP-backed Missouri map, preserving key seat for Democrats
description: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a Republican attempt at redistricting congressional seats in Missouri - possibly giving Democrats a boost in their effort to win the House in the midterm elections.
